en: Colorized landscape view over a rural lakeside scene. In the foreground there are wooden farm buildings with tiled and thatched roofs surrounded by trees and fields. Beyond them lie flat green meadows, a line of trees, and a broad lake stretching across the image, with low hills and a partly cloudy blue sky in the distance. Red printed text appears in the top right and top left corners, and vertically along the left edge.
